decisions.recommendation: maxbld-invariants.mjs 0.45, 0.2, 0.3, 4, 6.3, 3.5. Rule text: Step and evaluator-extension code holds no by-law knowledge as a literal; numbers allowed 0, 1, -1, 2, 100; strings limited to the closed status words in vocab.json and table field names.

decisions.subject: MB73: R-KQ
decisions.recommendation: Operator: "a final section in the plan to make sure we did everything we said we did ... airtight enforcement". decisions.subject: M-SWITCH: M-378
decisions.recommendation: Operator 2026-10-30: "turn on and off bylaws". Rule text: One switchboard, built by MB-31 at scripts/seeds/bylaw/switchboard.json (to be built by MB-31): rows {id, kind, state, ruling, reason}, kind in clause, formula, scenario, building_type, reading; default on, except where the switch's own ruling sets it off (shape_calibration, LC-69); off beats on; every result lists the switches on its path.

decisions.subject: M-SUITE: M-379
decisions.recommendation: Audit #11, #32, #49. Rule text: The house with a secondary suite differs from the detached house only through LC-33's closed gain reasons; INV-3 is about the rear suite.

decisions.subject: M-EXPECT: M-380
decisions.recommendation: MB-17 Q3 flip. Rule text: Expected answers are the authority: worked examples and fresh expected answers are protected paths; an accepted loop change names the cases it made pass; one Layer 3 writer.

decisions.subject: M-CONFLICT: M-381
decisions.recommendation: MB17-Q1 vs M-180(1). Rule text: Before a ruling is recommended, the register is searched for conflicting rows; every 69a, Spec 131 and Spec 124a row that cites the same clause, target or building type, and every other row of the same batch, is listed, each marked no conflict (with reason) or amends/supersedes.

decisions.subject: M-WIP: M-382
decisions.recommendation: Queue v2:4 (11 held patches + MB-64 patch). Rule text: Done means committed, named test green in the loop run, ruling recorded and queue line updated; at most N held patches, where N is a logic variable set by operator decision O-6 (unruled); a lane is one writer branch; built-ahead work is held only as a listed patch.

decisions.subject: M-OBJ: M-383
decisions.recommendation: Gap G-OBJ: 69:26 used the phrase undefined. Rule text: The five objectives (standardized, observable, scalable, accurate, understandable; R-BA, Spec 68 section 4) bind every McBylaws phase, measured by Spec 68 O-1..O-12 and SC-1..SC-20; McBylaws has no exception path other than BOOT-1 (R-KG); the objectives have one home, Spec 68 section 4, and this row only cites them.

decisions.subject: P3-MODEL: M-384
decisions.recommendation: Operator: "yes. we also dont want to import the old code ..." and "option a" (narrowed). Rule text: Phase 3 is tables, not code: formulas are data in a catalogue (code = one generic runner plus a closed helper list); no old code is imported (R-KJ); Phase 3 is a test-and-validate loop; every non-law setting is a logic variable and law numbers come only from Phase 2, except the front-yard data chain ruled by CHAT-210.MB54-Q, which uses data and settings, never law, and is flagged front_yard_needs_survey; building types, formulas, settings and switches are table rows.

decisions.subject: M61-CAT: M-377
decisions.recommendation: P3-DATA-MODEL ruling 1, 3, 5. Rule text: The formula catalogue is M-61's formula registry; it is built by MB-31 at scripts/seeds/bylaw/layer3-catalogue.json (to be built by MB-31); changing a calculation is editing a row and its examples; a form the grammar cannot express is a ruling to extend M-72; every change goes through the loop.

decisions.subject: START-SMALL: clause (4) of M-377
decisions.recommendation: Operator words quoted in the proposals. Rule text: Start small and expand through the loop: increment 1 is the detached house, core numbers only, on the 25 golden cases; each later increment adds one field, building type or case set and enters only when the previous is green in the loop.

decisions.subject: HDR: dated note on the 69a header
decisions.recommendation: audit 3.2. Rule text: The "Next free id" line of the 69a header is generated, not hand-kept (69a:12 said M-334; the highest id is M-376).

decisions.subject: R3-01: M-385
decisions.recommendation: F-51. Rule text: R3-01 Undecided never means zero: a not_evaluated or condition_unknown Phase 2 input makes every row that reads it not_evaluated with the reason carried forward; it is never treated as 0, as absent, or as unlimited.

decisions.subject: R3-02: M-386
decisions.recommendation: F-53. Rule text: R3-02 Flags propagate: needs_survey, user_supplied, shape_box_assumed, option:<id> and every disclosure on an input are inherited by every row derived from it, up to the headline.

decisions.subject: R3-03: M-387
decisions.recommendation: F-54, F-55. Rule text: R3-03 Front-yard chain: law stays in Phases 1-2; whether 10.5.40.70(1) applies is Phase 2's decision and the averaging arithmetic is the Phase 1 row's own expression; the chain is the one ruled exception (CHAT-210.MB54-Q): Phase 3 supplies only the neighbour-setback input in the ruled order, using data and settings, never law, flagged front_yard_needs_survey; the terminal is the zone value Phase 2 stores for x.40.70(1), used only where Phase 2 says 10.5.40.70(1) does not apply or as the flagged FS-SB2 last resort, never a typed 6.0; M-245 (no zone-default floor) and M-256 stand.

decisions.subject: R3-04: M-388
decisions.recommendation: F-56. Rule text: R3-04 Calibration is tested on held-out data: the oracle for the allowance is the FS-SB1 held-out half and the CoA-surveyed setbacks, never the lots it was fitted on.

decisions.subject: R3-05: M-389
decisions.recommendation: F-61. Rule text: R3-05 Options: an option whose space is zero or less, or that Phase 2 refuses, is dropped with its reason; if every option is dropped the result is not_permitted / not_evaluated with reasons; a suite split is scored only where Phase 2 permits the suite on that class.

decisions.subject: R3-06: M-390
decisions.recommendation: F-62. Rule text: R3-06 Ideal split breakpoints are generated, not hand-listed: the candidate splits are every depth at which some row in the split changes slope (each min() arm), held as catalogue rows, with both ends included; a tie goes to the larger main (LC-22); a dense-grid check runs in the test lane only.

decisions.subject: R3-08: M-391
decisions.recommendation: F-58. Rule text: R3-08 Storeys: Phase 2 decides whether a storey cap applies (10.20.40.10(3)(C) is stored as not_applicable); S-1 is only the height-to-storeys arithmetic, used only where Phase 2 stores the cap as not_applicable or unlimited; an absent or undecided cap is not_evaluated (M-385); S-1 counts storeys and is not a limit, so height alone still limits the building.

decisions.subject: R3-10: M-392
decisions.recommendation: F-60. Rule text: R3-10 Shape switch: shape_calibration = on requires a fitted footprint_shape_factor with its provenance (n cases, date, audit file) and the disclosure tied to the switch state; the bounds are logic variables (unruled); turning it on without a fit fails closed.

decisions.subject: R3-11: M-393
decisions.recommendation: F-63. Rule text: R3-11 Unresolved classes answer not_modelled: a building type with no Phase 2 class (houseplex 5-6) returns "not_modelled: class not resolved in Phase 2 (MB-27.L2)" and never falls back to a neighbouring class (M-194: the cap is 4 outside a confirmed 600.60 area).

decisions.subject: P2-OPT: M-400
decisions.recommendation: O-17 approved on CARD-plan-1030. Rule text: Phase 2 stores one result per design option (roof form; suite low/tall), keyed by option like class; options that give no different law answer share the cell; within an option the cell is decided; only Phase 3 compares options.

decisions.subject: SIX-COA: M-401
decisions.recommendation: O-18 approved on CARD-plan-1030. Rule text: Houseplex 5-6 units are modelled on every relevant lot with their permission route: as_of_right, coa_required or not_permitted (with its reason); a major-street result whose equivalence is unverified is shown unconfirmed and never as_of_right; the variances assumed are exactly the listed varied clauses, starting with the permission (10.20.20.40(1)) and including any option-dependent limit (for example 600.60.40(2)); a coa_required result is never shown as as-of-right. This amends M-194 (cap 6 only in a confirmed 600.60 area: outside it a 5-6 unit result is a coa_required route), M-214(1) (major-street forms not modelled: the permission is modelled) and M-64 (a not_permitted result of this class is shown with its reason); M-65 and LC-49 are unchanged.

decisions.subject: OPTIONS: M-402
decisions.recommendation: Operator: "calculate both and provide both as options". Rule text: Each building type lists its feasible design options, the largest marked as the headline; S-1 is a feasibility minimum, not one typical storey height; Phase 2 resolves per option only where an option changes a law answer (M-400).

decisions.subject: IDEAL-SPLIT: M-403
decisions.recommendation: operator words on CARD-operator-words-2026-10-30. Rule text: The rear suite and main house are split at the best breakpoint (total floor area = main + suite, both piecewise-linear in the main house depth); the candidate splits are the catalogue rows of M-390, scored by the evaluator, with the split disclosed and no search helper; a tie goes to the larger main (LC-22).

decisions.subject: FRONT-YARD: dated note on M-245
decisions.recommendation: records WHERE the ruled chain lives. Rule text: front_setback_used_m is one catalogue row that applies the ruled chain (user figure; estimate + allowance; FS-SB2 placeholder; zone fallback stored by Phase 2); the chain lives in the model path, not in a harness; every value except a user figure is flagged front_yard_needs_survey.

decisions.recommendation: P3-DATA-MODEL (a). Rule text: The closed scenario set becomes the building-types table scripts/seeds/bylaw/layer3-building-types.json (to be built by MB-31); semis are a recorded future build, counted not_evaluated:future_build.
